Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.di.tags

Klasse CollectionTag

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.jelly.TagSupport
net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.di.tags.AbstractBeanTag
net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.di.tags.CollectionTag
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
org.apache.commons.jelly.Tag
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
ListTag, SetTag
public abstract class CollectionTag extends AbstractBeanTag

A base tag handler class for defining collections in bean builder scripts.

This base class provides basic functionality for maintaining a collection with the dependencies representing the elements of the collection to be created. It defines an addElement() method to be called by tags in the body of this tag for adding new element dependencies to the collection. The type of the elements to add can be specified by attributes in this class. When adding new elements a type conversion will be performed if necessary. It is also possible to override the data type when adding a new element. This way collections with heterogeneous content can be created. However, the logic for type conversions is implemented by the tag handler classes that invoke the addElement() method. This base class also supports a name attribute. So both named and anonymous beans can be created.

    • addElement

      public void addElement(Dependency dep)
      Adds a new element to the collection managed by this tag. This method is intended to be called by tags in the body of this tag. It adds the given Dependency to the internal list of element dependencies.
      Parameter:
      dep - the dependency to be added (must not be null)
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the dependency is null

      protected void processBeforeBody() throws org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyTagException
